steps.eval: (() => { const A = window.__meridianAgent; const id = A.agents.getState().order[0]; A.view(id); A.send(id, 'Build a 30-story mixed-use tower on the vacant parcel beside Lavaca & 4th and tell me what it does to PM traffic'); return id; })()

steps.waitFor: () => { const A = window.__meridianAgent; const s = A.agents.getState().sessions[A.agents.getState().order[0]]; return s && s.status === 'idle' && s.items.some(i => i.kind === 'assistant' && i.done && i.segments.some(x => x.type === 'text' && x.text.startsWith('Done.'))); }

steps.eval: (() => { const A = window.__meridianAgent; const s = A.agents.getState().sessions[A.agents.getState().order[0]]; return { items: s.items.map(i => i.kind + (i.kind === 'assistant' ? ':' + i.segments.map(x => x.type === 'tool' ? `tool(${x.call.name}:${x.call.status})` : x.type + '[' + x.text.slice(0, 80) + ']').join(' ') : i.kind === 'notice' ? ':' + i.text : '')), lastRun: s.lastRun, changesets: s.changesets, scenario: window.__meridian.scenarios.active.name, edits: window.__meridian.scenarios.active.cursor }; })()
